security_spec.violation_condition: If an RTL implementation incorrectly classifies Svade/Svadu as unprivileged extensions, the A/D-bit update control field (menvcfg.ADUE / henvcfg.ADUE, bit 61) could be exposed at supervisor or user privilege levels via senvcfg or a user-accessible CSR instead of being restricted to M/HS-mode. In XiangShan, menvcfg.ADUE (CSRBundles.scala:71) is already RO=0 and menvcfg is M-mode-only (addr[9:8]=11), and henvcfg.ADUE (HypervisorLevel.scala:364-374) is also RO=0 with HS-mode+ access. However, if a future Svadu implementation added ADUE to senvcfg (SupervisorLevel.scala:259) or made it RW, U-mode software could probe A/D-bit behavior via timed page fault patterns to leak OS page table state, or VS-mode could override hypervisor A/D-bit policy.
security_spec.summary: Svade/Svadu reclassified from unprivileged to privileged: A/D-bit update control (menvcfg/henvcfg.ADUE) must remain M/HS-mode-only; exposing it at S/U-mode would let unprivileged software probe OS page-table state via page-fault timing.
